description: The chart illustrates the distribution of conversations across various categories, including Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism, with a focus on the number of conversations where participants were deceived. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, while the horizontal axis represents the number of conversations, ranging from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. Each category is represented by a grouped bar, comprising three bars colored red, yellow, and green, corresponding to the deception levels "Yes", "Partially", and an unlabeled category, respectively. The chart reveals that the category "Academic Funding" has the highest number of conversations where participants were deceived (red bar), with a value of approximately 58, while "Journalism" has the highest number of conversations where participants were partially deceived (yellow bar), with a value of around 48. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the number of conversations across different categories and deception levels.
